title: Home Trucking and Road Transport - American Road Haul LLC
lead: American Road Haul LLC offers comprehensive truckload transportation services with a world-class logistics network, cutting-edge technology, and dedicated support tailored to meet the evolving needs of our customers.

services.title: With our experience and access to thousands of carriers and their lanes, we can offer you the most economical way to ship your freight
services.quote: Request an LTL freight quote to start shipping through Swift Line’s LTL lanes here.

about.title: American Road Haul LLC’s experienced team connects you with reliable, efficient, and cost-effective freight solutions for every shipment.
about.text: As a client, you get exclusive access to our long-standing partnerships with the highest caliber independent carriers and large fleet carriers, plus the most competitive rates and reliable service out there, guaranteed!

why.title: American Road Haul LLC proudly serves customers nationwide, delivering reliable freight transportation solutions with a focus on safety, efficiency, and exceptional service.

tabs.label: 24\7 Support
tabs.text: We are available to the driver around the clock. Because our team consists of daytime dispatchers, after-hours dispatchers, night dispatchers, weekend dispatchers. We have separate check callers, accounting department, safety department, eld department and fleet manager. We provide a full range of services at any time of the day or night.

tabs.label: Flexibility
tabs.text: Non-forced dispatch—run the days and lanes you choose. Daily or weekly settlements – provided on time, as expected. Opportunities for a variety of freight.

tabs.label: Personal Guidance
tabs.text: Responsive back-office services. Assistance finding the freight you want.

tabs.label: Best rates
tabs.text: Our Owners get only the best loads. For sure +20% of the market average.

why.ctaTitle: Set your ship speed. We’ll get it there.

steps.p: Complete and sign the carrier agreement.
Add American Road Haul LLC to your insurance policy and provide an updated certificate.
Submit your active operating authority and supporting carrier documentation for verification.
Fill out and return a signed W-9 form to complete your company profile.
Once everything is approved, you’ll be ready to receive loads and start working with us.
